## Learn how moving to Sona drives efficiency and performance

Tell us about your operation and we'll show you what Sona can do to transform workforce management for your business.


### Tailored demo

We'll show you Sona configured for your sector and business size.


### ROI estimate

We'll model the real impact: time saved on scheduling, labour efficiency gains, and payroll accuracy.


### Clear next steps

You'll leave knowing exactly what implementation looks like, how long it takes, and what it costs.

Working with Sona


## Product excellence meets partnership commitment

### Product

Demand-Focused Workforce Intelligence


Built around what drives labour demand in your industry. We integrate with your operational data to systemise, optimise, and automate.


Complete End-to-End Platform


A single unified system spanning Core HR, scheduling, time & attendance, payroll, and communications. No manual data transfers.


Enterprise-Level Adaptability


A flexible platform designed for enterprise-level complexity that integrates easily with the tools your business already uses.


Consumer-Grade UX


Frontline employees get an intuitive, mobile-first experience with the familiarity and simplicity of a consumer app.


AI-Powered from Day One


Built with AI in mind from the start. Raffy, our AI assistant, supports managers with real-time insights and guidance.


### Partnership

Partner-Led from First Conversation


Discovery-led engagement ensures commercial, operational, and frontline realities shape the solution from day one.


Industry Expertise


Our team deeply understands the needs and challenges of your industry, helping find the right solution for your business.


Co-Designed Execution


We adapt both product configuration and implementation approach to work seamlessly for your operating model.


Long-Term Partnership


Technical account managers, regular business reviews, and customer advisory board membership keep you supported.


Proven Track Record


Join hundreds of organisations who have transformed their workforce operations with measurable improvements.
